name: Peach Cobbler

ingredients.item: sliced peaches in juice (15 oz each)

instructions: Melt butter in a 9x13 inch baking dish in the oven, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt together.
Stir in milk until a smooth batter forms.
Pour batter over melted butter — do not stir.
Spoon peaches with their juice over the batter — do not stir.
Bake 40-45 minutes until top is golden brown and edges are bubbling.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use oat milk and dairy-free butter.
substitutions.vegan: Use plant milk and vegan butter.

notes: Do not stir after adding butter, batter, or peaches — the layers self-sort during baking.
